title: 第268章 修脚的杨，到！呀咩咯，又要被这老鼠爽吃了！？
slug: 三角洲招募威龙创电竞gti

第(1/3)页

“三千万！这把不到三千万我不走！”

在亲眼目睹了蜂医手里那颗非洲之星的璀璨光芒后，杨起家的双眼已经完全被一种名为“贪婪”的光辉所笼罩。

就像他之前算的，他此时手里的曼德尔超算加上零碎的小红小金大约是三百万出头，

蜂医那边的非洲之星1314加上航天总裁卡七百多万再加其他零碎，是两千一百万左右。

也就是说，他们两个人的背包和保险加一起，现在大约是两千五百万。

这才刚吃了个宿舍啊！

在这样的环境下，两千五百万加上后续再吃一些东西，以及如果能成功修脚一两队人的话——

三千万，真不是梦啊！

【杨哥上头了，这下彻底上头了！】

【笑死，说好的是来体验搜索快乐的呢，这会儿又要当修脚师傅了？】

【是啊，既然这把这么有爆率，为什么不再去其他地方继续摸金？】

【本质邪恶人格顶号，有没有懂得？】

【不要啊杨哥，你会消失的！】

看到弹幕的呼喊，你杨哥却是嘿嘿一笑，

“别怕啊兄弟们，撑死胆大的饿死胆小的！反正那个号的心和卡都在保险里，就算最后我们死了，少了我这一个曼德尔也依旧是拯救成功了！”

“但如果没死呢？三千万的单局收入那可是创造历史啊！”

“走，先去人机盒子里翻翻看，找把射速快的冲锋枪，这就够了！”

说干就干。

杨起家操作着角色转身回了宿舍区域，开始在那些被系统AI击杀后掉落的绿色人机盒子里翻找了起来。

第一个盒子，野牛和两个弹匣。

“野牛也行吧….但射速有点慢了，换一个看看。”

第二个盒子，人机霰弹枪，还是只能两发两发射的那种。

“不是，这什么玩意，实在不行给我来个UZi也行啊！”

第三个盒子，第四个盒子.....

终于，在一路来到快接近一元位置的时候，杨起家才终于看到了这样一个算是意外之喜的武器！

杨起家当场眼睛就亮了。

在三角洲的正常对局里，这勇士冲锋枪可谓是垃圾到不能再垃圾，跑刀都不用来卡战备的武器了！

在修脚这个领域，射速就是正义，

勇士的射速和肉伤害就是要比正常的人机枪，UZi和野牛要快或者稳。

哪怕它装的是人机标配的二级弹，但修脚又不打甲，二级弹三级弹有什么区别？

杨起家赶紧把这把勇士和旁边那些散落的弹匣全都收了起来。

在发现一旁的蜂医也不知道从哪摸了一把勇士后，两人这才终于做好了战前准备！

“蜂医哥，帮我看一眼西大那边的门开了没有。”

“收到。”

蜂医操作角色移动到了宿舍区域能够观察到西区大门的位置，仔细看了一眼后回复道。

“西大门没开，这把西区没出生人。”

“那就是中控和发射必刷了？再加上刚才我打跑的牢区那队….”杨起家迅速在脑内梳理着全图的人员分布。

而就在他们整理完情报，准备开始往中控方向移动的时候——

砰砰砰！嗒嗒嗒嗒！

剧烈的枪声忽然从中控沙地方向传了过来。

那声音杨起家一听就知道是什么——M7和M14！

前者是三角洲中公认的T0步枪，射速一般但伤害极高，胸腹同伤。

后者则是同样恐怖的近战利器，见面就是融化！

“卧槽卧槽卧槽，M14！还有M7！”

杨起家下意识压低了声音，虽然他们现在离战场还隔着挺远的距离，但那种面对满改好枪时的本能畏惧还是让他不由自主地夹住了屁股。

嗯，只是紧张而已，没别的意思。

“听枪声位置，应该是中控出生的队伍和牢区的在沙地附近交火了。”

“M14应该是中控那队的，M7….可能是牢区那边的。”

蜂医通过信息给出了基础的分析。

而杨起家闻言之后一边点头，一边眼神也变得越来越亮了！

“也就是说….等他们打完，不管哪边赢了，肯定都会有伤亡，有救人的。”

“而救人的时候，就是他们最脆弱的时候。”

“懂了！摸过去！修脚！”

【杨区家上线了！】

【来了来了，经典的战后捡漏环节，你杨哥的老本行！】

【就说嘛，能靠偷鸡绝不正面刚，这才是你杨哥的真正面目！】

"Thirty million! I won't leave if this one is less than thirty million!"

After witnessing the dazzling light of the African Star in the bee doctor's hand, Yang Qijia's eyes were completely shrouded in a light called "greed".

Just as he had calculated before, the Mandel supercomputer in his hand at this time plus the scattered little red and small gold was about over three million.

Bee Doctor’s Africa Star 1314 plus Aerospace President Card is over 7 million plus other bits and pieces, which is about 21 million.

In other words, the combined backpacks and insurance for the two of them are now about 25 million.

I just had a dormitory!

In such an environment, 25 million, plus some food to eat later, and if one or two people can successfully get pedicures——

Thirty million is really not a dream!

[Brother Yang is over the top, completely over the top now!】

[Laughing, you promised to come here to experience the joy of searching, but now you want to be a pedicure master again?】

[Yeah, since this one has such an explosion rate, why don’t you continue to find gold elsewhere?】

[The number one with an intrinsically evil personality, do you understand?】

[No, Brother Yang, you will disappear!】

Seeing the shouts on the barrage, Brother Yang smiled and said,

"Don't be afraid, brothers, the brave will starve to death and the timid will starve! Anyway, the heart and card of that number are insured. Even if we die in the end, without me, Mandel, the rescue will still be successful!"

"But what if he didn't die? A single game income of 30 million would be history-making!"

"Let's go and look through the man-machine box first to find a submachine gun with a fast firing rate. That's enough!"

Just do it.

Yang Qijia controlled the character and turned back to the dormitory area, and began to rummage through the green man-machine boxes dropped after being killed by the system's AI.

First box, bison and two mags.

"The bison will work too...but the firing rate is a bit slow. Let's try another one."

The second box, the human-machine shotgun, is still the kind that can only fire two rounds.

"No, what the hell is this? If it doesn't work, just give me a UZI!"

The third box, the fourth box...

Finally, when he was approaching the one-yuan position, Yang Qijia finally saw such an unexpected weapon!

Yang Qijia's eyes lit up on the spot.

In a normal game in the Delta, this Warrior submachine gun can be described as rubbish to the point of being rubbish, and the running knife is not even used as a combat-ready weapon!

In the field of pedicure, speed of fire is justice;

The Warrior's rate of fire and physical damage are faster or more stable than normal man-machine guns, UZi and Bison.

Even if it is loaded with the standard second-level bullets for man-machine, but the pedicure does not hit the armor, what is the difference between the second-level bullets and the third-level bullets?

Yang Qijia quickly collected the Warrior and the scattered magazines next to it.

After discovering that the bee doctor on the side had touched a warrior from nowhere, the two finally made preparations for the battle!

"Brother Bee Doctor, help me see if the door on the West University side is open."

"Roger that."

The bee doctor moved his character to the dormitory area where he could observe the gate of the West District, took a closer look and replied.

"The west gate is not open, so no one is born in the west area."

"Then the central control and launch must be refreshed? In addition to the team in the cell area that I just defeated..." Yang Qijia quickly sorted out the personnel distribution of the entire map in his mind.

And just when they finished sorting out the information and were about to start moving towards the central control——

Bang bang bang!Ta-ta-ta-ta!

Violent gunshots suddenly came from the direction of Zhongkong Sandi.

When Yang Qijia heard the sound, he knew what it was - M7 and M14!

The former is a recognized T0 rifle in the Delta. It has an average rate of fire but extremely high damage, injuring both the chest and abdomen.

The latter is an equally terrifying melee weapon that melts when you meet it!

"Holy shit, shit, shit, M14! And M7!"

Yang Qijia lowered his voice subconsciously. Although they were still far away from the battlefield, the instinctive fear when facing Mangai's good gun still made him involuntarily clamp his buttocks.

Well, I'm just nervous, nothing else.

"From the location of the gunfire, it should be that the team born in the central control area and the prison area were exchanging fire near the sand."

"M14 should be from the central control team, and M7...may be from the prison area."

The bee doctor gives a basic analysis through the information.

After hearing this, Yang Qijia nodded, and his eyes became brighter and brighter!

"That is to say...when they finish fighting, no matter which side wins, there will definitely be casualties and rescuers."

"And when you save people, that's when they are at their most vulnerable."

"Got it! Touch it! Get a pedicure!"

[Yang District’s family is online!】

[Come on, come on, the classic post-war picking up missing items, your old specialty, Brother Yang!】

[Let’s just say, if you can steal chickens, you will never be arrogant. This is your true face, Brother Yang!】
